attributes.action: Humanitarian and human rights concerns in Azad Kashmir
attributes.additional_details:
We ask the UK Government to assess reported human rights and humanitarian concerns in Azad Kashmir and raise them with Pakistan.

Reports from people with family ties include food shortages, communication and internet disruptions, and protests about living conditions and rights.

We ask the Government to assess the situation, seek information on reported restrictions, raise concerns about civilian welfare and rights, support access to essential goods and free expression, and update Parliament on any action taken.

We believe civilians should have access to food, communication, and peaceful protest rights, and ask the Government to monitor and respond appropriately.
attributes.background: We ask the Government to support the people of Kashmir withour families being restricted access to food, communication and internet disruptions, and protests about living conditions and rights by the Pakistani Government.

rejection.details: You may wish to sign this petition, which calls for similar action: "Raise Human Rights Issues in Azad Kashmir with the Government of Pakistan" https://petition.parliament.uk/petitions/772026
